item.title: DevPulse 0.1.0
item.description:
• First version.
  • Menu bar dashboard: your pull requests, review requests, Jira tickets and Claude Code sessions in one popover, with each source's last update or error; the icon counts direct review requests and sessions waiting for you.
  • Notifications for new review requests, comments on your pull requests and tickets, finished CI runs, and Claude Code sessions that wait for you or finish; clicking one opens the page or the session. Each source and each kind of notification can be switched off in Settings.
  • Settings window: refresh interval, launch at login, the quick launcher shortcut, GitHub status and team review requests, Jira site, e-mail and API token (kept in the Keychain) with a connection test, default repository and project, notifications and updates.
  • Quick launcher on a global shortcut (⌥Space by default): type gh or jira to list, filter or open pull requests and tickets by title, number or key; ⌘Enter opens a pull request's Jira ticket.
  • Clicking a Claude Code session brings its Ghostty window to the front.
  • devpulse terminal UI, lazygit-style: numbered panels for pull requests, review requests, Jira tickets and Claude Code sessions with a detail pane, live updates, / filter, ? help, mouse clicks and wheel, and automatic reconnect when the app restarts; J opens the Jira ticket of a pull request or session, and review requests are marked as direct or team ones.
  • devpulse upgrade installs the latest version from the terminal.
  • Updates: DevPulse asks at every launch whether a newer version exists and installs it only after you agree; Settings › Updates has "Check Now" and turns the automatic check off.
  • GitHub and Jira refresh every 2 minutes (1–30 in Settings), pause while the Mac sleeps or the screen is locked, and refresh right after waking or unlocking.
  • Website and manual in English and Czech.
  • "Install command line tool" in Settings › General puts devpulse on your PATH.
